note: Ventura County park on Santa Paula Creek off Highway 150 north of Santa Paula, among oaks and sycamores below the mountains, with an aviary and picnic grounds. The campground loop sits between the highway and the creek, its north end at the edge of the creek's gravel bed. Generators off 10 pm-7 am. The separate campground across the creek is the Ventura Ranch KOA, on land leased from the county. --Claude
summary: County page read via Wayback (live site F5-blocked; Itinio engine behind an AWS WAF CAPTCHA). Tent/dry RV $27-29, full hookup $50-52 (10 FHU sites), 6 people, 14-night max, showers; sewer added. Creekside kept on imagery of the loop's north end at the creek bed (no site numbers available).
flags: WATERFRONT (kept creekside, weak): the county page markets 'creek side camping'; on Esri the campground loop (~34.4067-34.4076,-119.0828/-119.0820) meets Santa Paula Creek's open gravel bed at its north/east end, the wetted channel ~25-30 m from the nearest pads with scattered riparian trees and no road between; the south-east dirt strip is behind a denser tree fringe. Santa Paula Creek is creek-sized (a few metres wetted).
